summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The engineering standard this node holds, in one sentence. The standard's AS-n rules are NOT a field here: they stay in the structured extra.rules, each with the four parts current_reality, target_rule, current_exceptions and migration.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Which code the standard governs, and which it does not.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.description: What checks the standard today (a test, a linter, a gate), or that nothing does.

debt_refs.title: Known debt
debt_refs.description: AD-n ids of debt entries that still violate it.

dimensions.question: What fails when someone violates this standard, and is that a machine check or only a review comment?
Where does the code violate this standard today, and is each place listed as debt?
